items.title: Steel Dynamics and Nucor Fall as Guidance Disappoints. What It Means for the Steel Sector.
items.summary: Shares of  Steel Dynamics  and  Nucor  each declined Friday as the two steel manufacturers issued quarterly guidance that was below Wall Street expectations even as U.S. steel prices have advanced significantly over the past 12 months.  Steel Dynamics stock fell 3.8% to $235.97 on Friday after ending Thursday up 3%.  Nucor stock, meanwhile, dropped 4.8% to $252.62 and was one of the worst-performing components in the  for the trading session.
